rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only candidate must retain or improve registered finish-line crossing completion before lap time matters.
observable_information: Current 84x84 grayscale road rows, pixel obstacle diagnostic, and the selected fixed-hash actor's action.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Apply a bounded early steering cue toward a consistent far-road bend only while the selected actor's steering is near zero; leave gas and brake unchanged.
expected_success_endpoint: At least the selected control's finished-cell count across twelve untouched matched confirmation cells, then lower median finished lap time on a tie.
control: Selected full-road-guard exact-hash historical checkpoint, otherwise identical environment, map/seed cells, and decision cap.
falsifier: Fewer actual finishes than control, invalid action, no preview activation, or equal finish count without lower median finished lap time.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Tracks 1, 2, 3 crossed with unopened seeds 312-315; selected and anticipatory arms, twelve matched cells per arm, 2000 decisions per cell.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU, 1200-second registered diagnostic limit, frozen source, no website action, no use of reserved blind cells.
